info.title: LOLDEX public read-only API
info.description: Release-local immutable API. Stable /api/v1 URLs redirect to a retained release. Use the final retained URL to pin pagination and dependencies. Duplicate parameters and arrays are rejected. ASCII A-Z folding only; Unicode is exact UTF-8. Confidence and provenance belong to individual claims. Search NOT subtrees have independent evidence scope. No authentication or writes. PHP query fallback: ./api-v1.php?resource=search&q=... . Public CORS exposes ETag, X-LOLDEX-Dataset and Retry-After; conditional responses verify consumed file hashes before 304. Shared fixed-window admission quotas: 120 requests/client/minute and 3000 globally/minute; corrupt or unavailable private state fails closed. OPTIONS is exempt. Retry-After is present on admission refusal; responses are no-store.
